applicant_utility.summary: There is nothing to apply for separately - this award rides on the programme application, so the only real task is applying early, because your scholarship eligibility is judged at the moment the programme application closes. NZ$15,000 covers one year of fees only, so treat it as a first-year discount inside a multi-year bachelor's budget rather than a funding solution.
applicant_utility.best_fit: New international fee-paying students starting a full-time on-campus Bachelor's at Victoria University of Wellington.
application_readiness_checklist: Apply for your Bachelor's programme before its programme-specific closing date - the scholarship is judged at that moment
Confirm you are a fee-paying international student entering the first year
Plan funding for years two and three, which this scholarship does not touch
Note the August 2025 restructuring if you were relying on the old Tongarewa or school-leaver schemes
common_rejection_risks: Applying for a postgraduate qualification - this award is for first-year Bachelor's entrants
Studying part-time or offshore, which are outside the award
Assuming the scholarship follows you into later years
Being an existing or continuing international student expecting the replaced Tongarewa scheme
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Living costs, travel, insurance and all tuition beyond the first year's NZ$15,000.

15 scholarships available each year across vocational, undergraduate, graduate and postgraduate study up to doctoral level

Involved in the local community and, where possible, the Pacific community

applicant_utility.summary: This is an annual 30 September deadline with no grace period - late entries are explicitly not accepted, and an application missing its supporting documents is treated as incomplete rather than incomplete-but-promising. Decisions rest with the Pacific Education Foundation board and are final, so invest your effort in the documents rather than in any appeal.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Pacific New Zealand citizens or permanent residents enrolled in full-time tertiary study, including vocational training up to doctoral level.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm full-time enrolment at a New Zealand tertiary provider - part-time study is ineligible
Read the application guidance PDF before starting the online form
Assemble every supporting document before submitting, since incomplete applications are not assessed
Submit before 11.59pm on 30 September in the round for your study year
If career-changing, note the board decides whether your course fits the career-changer category
common_rejection_risks: Late submission after the 30 September 11.59pm close
Missing supporting documents, which makes the application incomplete and unassessed
Part-time study, which is not eligible
Not being a New Zealand citizen or permanent resident
Expecting feedback - the board does not provide individual feedback on applications
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Living costs and any study expenses beyond the awarded amount, which is set at programme level.
document_audit: The application guide PDF lists the required documents - read it first, not after submitting
The career-changer stream is judged by the board on whether the course fits that category
Outcomes arrive by email in mid-December, with no appeal route
alerts: One quarter of awards is steered to priority fields (STEM, health, digital/AI, engineering and trades, education workforce, green and climate) - field choice affects your odds
